claims.statement: For every n>=1, every restriction of F_n(z,x)=(-1)^{z sum_j x_j}(1-2 1_{x=0}), and every product of such a restriction with an arbitrary disjoint affine-quadratic phase, G(f)<=8 I(f).
claims.quantifiers: All n>=1; arbitrary disjoint quadratic rank and total dimension; uniform-cube Boolean functions; base-2 units.

claims.statement: On the same restriction-closed class, U(f)<=8 I(f) and H(f)<=18 I(f).
claims.scope_note: Proper expanding class only; this does not settle full FEI.

claims.statement: No dimension-independent control of the aggregate upper-set asymmetry mismatch is proved for arbitrary changing coherent cores with reused physical variables.
claims.delta: The gap is removed for one full-star point-defect block and disjoint quadratic extensions, but not for arbitrary hierarchies.
